text: dsh-custom-brand 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的品牌区自定义插件。它通过浏览器模块加载器注入侧栏品牌区域，在鲸鱼图标、DeepSeek 字样和 HARNESS 徽标上叠加可编辑区域。用户可以选择本地图像替换图标或字样，双击编辑徽标文字，右键恢复图像或原始字样；自定义徽标还会同步到浏览器标签标题。图片会缩放后保存，徽标文字和图片数据保存在浏览器 localStorage，刷新后仍可读取。适合希望个性化 DSH 网页侧栏品牌显示的用户；不需要 API 密钥或外部服务。

dsh-custom-brand customizes the DSH Web sidebar. Double-click the whale logo or DeepSeek wordmark to choose a local image, or edit the HARNESS badge; right-click restores defaults. The badge name updates the browser tab title. Text and resized images persist in localStorage. No API key is needed.
想把网页侧栏里的默认鲸鱼标志换成自己的图片。
能不能把品牌区的 DeepSeek 字样替换成自选图像？
我想给侧栏的 HARNESS 徽标改个名字并保留下来。
怎么把 DSH 网页左上角的鲸鱼和品牌文字换成自己的素材？
希望改完品牌徽标后浏览器标签页标题也跟着更新。
替换过的侧栏图标能不能在重新打开网页后还在？
Can I personalize the sidebar logo and wordmark with images from my computer?
I want to rename the badge in the web sidebar and keep the new label after reloads.
dsh-custom-brand 的功能「替换鲸鱼图标」：在侧栏品牌图标上双击并选择本地图像，即可覆盖默认鲸鱼；图片会缩放并保存，右键可恢复默认图标。
dsh-custom-brand 的功能「自定义品牌字样」：双击 DeepSeek 字样选择本地图像替换，右键该区域即可恢复原始文字，徽标层仍保持独立显示。
dsh-custom-brand 的功能「编辑徽标文字」：双击 HARNESS 徽标输入新文字，按 Enter 保存或按 Esc 取消；新名称也会显示为浏览器标签页标题。
dsh-custom-brand 的功能「恢复默认品牌素材」：对自定义图标或字样区域右键，可移除对应保存值并重新显示默认鲸鱼图案或 DeepSeek 字样。
dsh-custom-brand 将徽标文字和选取的图像数据保存在当前浏览器的 localStorage 中，因此自定义内容随浏览器配置保存。

dsh-custom-brand README · dsh-custom-brand：Customizable brand area for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web GUI — replace the whale logo and the DeepSeek wordmark with your own local images, and edit the HARNESS badge text. Everything persists in `localStorage` and survives restarts.

DSH Web 界面左上角品牌区自定义插件：鲸鱼 logo 与 DeepSeek 文字可换成你自己的本地图片，HARNESS 徽章文字可双击编辑。所有修改保存在浏览器 `localStorage`，重启不丢。

dsh-custom-brand README · Features / 功能：| Area | Interaction |
| --- | --- |
| Whale logo / 鲸鱼 logo | **Double-click** to pick a local image (auto-downscaled to 256px, PNG keeps transparency); **right-click** to restore the default whale |
| DeepSeek wordmark / DeepSeek 文字 | **Double-click** to pick a local image; **right-click** to restore the original lettering |
| HARNESS badge / HARNESS 徽章 | **Double-click** to edit the text (styled like the original badge letterforms); Enter to commit, Esc to cancel |
| Browser tab title / 标签页标题 | Syncs to the badge text |

dsh-custom-brand README · Install / 安装：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:<owner>/dsh-custom-brand
```

or in the DSH settings → Plugins market, search `dsh-custom-brand`. 或在 DSH 设置 → 插件市场中搜索安装。

dsh-custom-brand README · Usage / 使用：1. Hover the brand area in the top-left sidebar — a dashed outline hints where editing is available.
2. Double-click the whale or the DeepSeek text to open the file picker; choose any image (PNG/JPG/WebP…). It is scaled to fit the small slot automatically.
3. Right-click an image slot to reset it to the original artwork.
4. Double-click the HARNESS badge and type a new name; the browser tab title updates with it.
dsh-custom-brand README · Usage / 使用：Stored keys (browser `localStorage`): `dsh.customLogo`, `dsh.customDeepSeekImg`, `dsh.customBrand`.

dsh-custom-brand README · Development / 开发：This is a standard DSH bundle:

- `lib/index.js` — host half (intentionally empty; all behavior is client-side)
- `lib/client.js` — browser half, registered via `window.__ModuleLoader__.load`; it patches the live brand DOM, supporting both the current plain-text wordmark layout (separate `brandMark` / `brandName` hosts) and the older combined-svg layout
- `cordis.patch.yml` — loader row inserting the plugin

Build the tarball with:

```sh
pnpm pack
```
